Observations
· [assistant] MTP3 trades a little single-stream decode (one fewer speculated token per draft) for lower spec-decode overhead - decode deltas here sit at the edge of the noise floor, matching community findings that MTP3 >= MTP4 overall. (verified this run)
· [assistant] Quality untouched, as expected: identical checkpoint + parsers; scores match the v033 row cell-for-cell (8/8, all games playable). (verified this run)
· [assistant] seqs4 is invisible to this single-stream harness by construction - its payoff (chat + agent tool-calls + memory extraction no longer serializing on one slot) is measured in the agent, not the scorecard. (design intent)
Still to verify
· 180 W power cap not yet applied on the B70 (needs root; deferred by owner) - power numbers not recorded in this row.
· If worst-case 4x100K concurrency is ever needed, raise gpu-mem-util 0.88 -> ~0.93 for ~206K KV (vLLM log suggests 0.8870 already recovers CUDA-graph overhead).
· Candidate follow-up: AutoRound GPTQ checkpoint (12/12 on the 12-canary suite vs 10-11/12 here) could be served through this same vLLM config someday.

fib.txt (154 bytes, full file beside this page)

def fib(n):
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative")
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return a
